faqs.question: What services does SysInt offer?
faqs.answer: SysInt offers Enterprise Integration (Azure Integration Services, BizTalk migration, API modernization) and AI Engineering (AI Integration, Agentic Automation, Inference Platforms, Intelligent Apps). We also have an AI Agent Store for local businesses.

faqs.question: What is the AI Agent Store?
faqs.answer: The AI Agent Store provides ready-to-deploy AI chatbots for local businesses — restaurants, salons, clinics, real estate, retail, home services, legal, and education. Agents go live in 48 hours.

faqs.question: Do you help with BizTalk migration?
faqs.answer: Yes — BizTalk to Azure migration is one of our deepest capabilities. We bring 20+ years of BizTalk expertise and handle assessment, pattern preservation, and cloud-ready deployment.

faqs.question: What Azure integration services do you work with?
faqs.answer: We work with Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management, Event Grid, and Data Factory — the full Azure Integration Services stack.

faqs.question: How do I get an AI agent for my local business?
faqs.answer: Contact us at 440-364-6078 or gangadhar.ananthoju@sysintinc.com. We'll match the right agent to your industry and get you live within 48 hours.

faqs.question: How long does it take to go live?
faqs.answer: Local business AI agents typically go live in 48 hours — just a 20-minute setup call. Enterprise integration projects start delivering value within 2–4 weeks of kickoff.

faqs.question: What industries do you serve with AI agents?
faqs.answer: Restaurants, salons & spas, medical clinics, real estate, retail, home services, legal & professional services, and education.

faqs.question: Do local businesses need their own domain?
faqs.answer: No — a domain is optional. Without one, your site runs on yourshopname.sysintinc.com (like elite.sysintinc.com) at no extra cost. If you want a custom domain like yoursalon.com, we can set it up for an additional fee depending on availability, plus an annual renewal charge — typically $15–$50/year.

faqs.question: How do I contact SysInt?
faqs.answer: Call 440-364-6078, email gangadhar.ananthoju@sysintinc.com, or visit www.sysintinc.com.

faqs.question: Who founded SysInt?
faqs.answer: SysInt Inc was founded by Ganga Ananthoju, Founder & AI Engineer, with 20+ years of enterprise integration experience.

faqs.question: What AI platforms and models do you work with?
faqs.answer: We work with Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and open-source inference platforms. We handle model deployment, guardrails, observability, and routing for production-ready AI delivery.
